blast.line: I know, the days are reeling past in such squealing blasts
blast.linePrev: Ask your hands to know the things they hold
blast.lineNext: But stop for breath and you will know it's yours

cast.line: The hospital asked, "Should the body be cast?"
stanza: The hospital asked, "Should the body be cast?"
Before I say goodbye, my star in the sky
Such a funny thought to wrap you up in cloth
Do you find it all right, my dragonfly?

fast.line: 'Cause things are gonna change so fast
stanza: He says:
"When you gonna make up your mind?
When you gonna love you as much as I do?
When you gonna make up your mind?
'Cause things are gonna change so fast
All the white horses are still in bed
I tell you that I'll always want you near
You say that things change, my dear"

fast.line: I hear the birds on the summer breeze, I drive fast
stanza: I hear the birds on the summer breeze, I drive fast
I am alone at midnight
Been trying hard not to get into trouble, but I
I've got a war in my mind
Hummingbird watching
Watching her young thing
Grow up so fast
Looking up to her
Watching her do her makeup and hair

fast.line: Well, outside the law your luck will run out fast
stanza: Well, outside the law your luck will run out fast
And a few years came and went
Until he's trapped in an alley in Abilene
With all but four shells spent

fast.line: And all the people hurried past real fast
stanza: He took a step, but then felt tired
He said, "I'll rest a little while"
But when he tried to walk again
He wasn't a child
And all the people hurried past real fast
And no one ever smiled

Under starless skies we are lost
And into the breach we got tossed

I was screaming, "Run, forty-four"

Oh, where'd you go, Forrest? (Sure is fast)

last.line: I see the past, it's all that lasts
stanza: Hiding out inside my head
It's me again, it's no surprise
I'm on my own now
Every  time I turn to you
I see the past, it's all that lasts
And all I know how
Learn to look me in the eyes
Yet I still don't feel it's me you're facing
Say your heart is always mine
What about old times? You can't erase them

last.line: These days nothing’s made to last
stanza: (Chorus)
Sometimes it still gonna rain
God knows we’re still gonna fight
We’re broken in bashed up ways
It’s a crazy kind of world to survive
These days nothing’s made to last
World keeps changing its mind
But you and I, we’re getting better with time
I remembered you older and taller
But you're younger and smaller
So who's gonna call her and say
That you're here at last?
I don't want to hold you and feel so helpless
I don't want to smell you and lose my senses
And smile in slow motion
With eyes in love
I twist like a corkscrew
The sweetness rising
I drink from the bottle, weeping
Why won't you last?
Why can't you last?

last.line: Transfiguration's gonna come for me at last
stanza: And I start laughing like a child
And I mark their faces one by one
Transfiguration's gonna come for me at last
And I will burn hotter than the sun

last.line: Ah, but now, I'm out of prison, I got me a friend at last
stanza: Ah, but now, I'm out of prison, I got me a friend at last
He don't drink or steal or cheat or lie
Ah his name is Codeine, he's the nicest thing I've seen
Well, together, we're gonna wait around and die
Yeah, together, we're gonna wait around and die

last.songTitle: By the Time It Gets Dark
last.line: You may be sad but it never lasts
stanza: Yesterday is gone and will be forgotten
And today is where every new day starts
Got to be free as the leaves in Autumn
You may be sad but it never lasts
Just like our last kiss
Forever the name on my lips
Forever the name on my lips
Just like our last

mast.line: Sails at the windows, forests of masts
stanza: And the pieces will lay there a while
In a house draped in net
In a room filled with coral
Sails at the windows, forests of masts
Put your hand over the side of the boat
Put your hand over the side of the boat
And what do you feel?

past.line: You pass through an ever present past
stanza: When you pass through the fire, you pass through humble
You pass through a maze of self doubt
When you pass through humble, the lights can blind you
Some people never figure that out
You pass through arrogance, you pass through hurt
You pass through an ever present past
And it's best not to wait for luck to save you
Pass through the fire to the light
Pass through the fire to the light
Pass through the fire to the light
It's best not to wait for luck to save you
Pass through the fire to the light

stanza: I should have known better
Nothing can be changed
The past is still the past
The bridge to nowhere
I should have wrote a letter
Explaining what I feel, that empty feeling

past.line: Sometimes I ricochet from the past
stanza: Sometimes I ricochet from the past
And at times, a future I've already had before

Either/or

past.line: It's one of my faults that I can't quell my past
stanza: I'm certain I am alone
In harbouring thoughts of our home
It's one of my faults that I can't quell my past
I ought to have gotten it gone

past.line: A memory from your lonesome past
stanza: I tried so hard, my dear
To show that you're my every dream
Yet you're afraid each thing I do
Is just some evil scheme

Why can't I free your doubtful mind

past.line: But in those years are the lifetimes past
stanza: I haven't felt this way I feel

But in those years are the lifetimes past
I did not deal with the road
And I did not deal with you, I know
Though the love has always been
So I search to find an answer there
So I can truly win
Alive with a past
No other can share
Alone with a heart
No other can bear
So give me some heaven
Just for a while
Make me eternal
There in your smile
